voices.note: אמרו לו (36b.11-37a.1) -- the respondents to R' Yehuda in the four-species baraita, arguing R' Meir's view
the 37a.3 baraita on cedar boards (= the 14b.10 baraita)
אמרי בי רב -- reported by Rabba bar Rav Huna

props.gloss_en: R' Yehuda (the mishnah): one may bind the lulav only with its own species
Rava: [one may bind it] even with palm bast, even with the trunk-wood of the palm
Rava: R' Yehuda's reason -- he holds the lulav requires binding
and if one brings another species [to bind it], there are five species
Rava: palm bast and the palm's trunk-wood are of the lulav's species
R' Meir: a sukkah [may be roofed] of any material
R' Meir: from 'in sukkot shall you dwell' (Lev 23:42) -- a sukkah of anything
R' Yehuda: the sukkah is [roofed] only with the four species of the lulav
and so in Ezra it says: 'go out to the mountain and bring olive leaves and pine leaves and myrtle leaves and palm leaves and leaves of thick trees to make sukkot as it is written' (Neh 8:15)
and R' Yehuda holds: these [olive and pine] are for the walls; myrtle, palm and thick-tree leaves are for the sekhakh
and we learned (the mishnah, 14a): one may roof with boards -- R' Yehuda
if he roofed it with cedar boards four tefachim wide, all agree it is pesula
[cedar boards] under four tefachim: R' Meir invalidates
and R' Yehuda validates [cedar boards under four]
R' Meir concedes that if there is a board's width between board and board, one places psal between them and it is kesheira
what is the 'cedar' [of the baraita]? myrtle
there are ten kinds of erez [and the myrtle is one of them]
as it is said: 'I will set in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia and the myrtle...' (Isa 41:19)

schemas.gloss_en: והדין נותן: ומה לולב שאין נוהג בלילות כבימים אינו נוהג אלא בארבעת מינין, סוכה שנוהגת בלילות כבימים אינו דין שלא תהא אלא בארבעת מינין -- the lulav, not practiced by night as by day, is only of the four species; the sukkah, practiced by night as by day, surely only of the four species

restricted_by.gloss_en: אמרו לו: כל דין שאתה דן תחלתו להחמיר וסופו להקל אינו דין -- and here (37a.1): לא מצא ארבעת מינין יהא יושב ובטל, the stringency ends in leaving the mitzva unfulfilled. Stated by the baraita's respondents (chachamim_baraita); not refuted in the text

supports.gloss_en: מנא אמינא לה ... דתניא: רבי יהודה אומר אין סוכה נוהגת אלא בארבעה מינים שבלולב -- first premise of Rava's proof (kind svara: no SupportKind for מנא אמינא לה דתניא; header)

ותנן: מסככין בנסרין, דברי רבי יהודה. אלמא סיב ועיקרא דדיקלא מינא דלולבא הוא -- with the first premise, R' Yehuda's boards must be of the four species (Steinsaltz: boards come only from the palm trunk, so the trunk counts as lulav)
והתורה אמרה: בסוכות תשבו שבעת ימים -- סוכה של כל דבר
